'''Team gamed!de''' is a german multigaming eSports team, founded in 2007.

== History ==
{{TDRight
|name1=2011
|name2=2012
|name3=2013}}
{{TDRight|tab}}<!--2013-->
* January 21, [[Sebastian (Sebastian Grune)|Sebastian]], [[gazek]], [[dX]], [[Platin]], [[Buddha]] and [[Bambino]] leave. <ref>[http://tera-gaming.de/index/news/view/id/13 Ziel S3 Quali - Tera mit gamed!de LoL Lineup (German)] ''tera-gaming.de''</ref>
* January 29, '''Team gamed!de''' reforms with '''[[Snow (Mirco Janke)|Snow]]''', '''[[Gnom Be Spy]]''', '''[[llnightmare]]''', '''[[Nicodd]]''', '''[[SunnyXX]]''' and '''[[bonaparte313]]'''.<ref>[http://team.gamed.de/index2.php?include=inc/news.php&id=1113 Wir begrüßen neues EPS LoL-Team (German)] ''team.gamed.de''</ref>
* ???, Roster disbands.
{{TDRight|tab}}<!--2012-->
* January 29, '''[[Arroganz]]''', '''[[Entenzwerg]]''', '''[[Gruhlum]]''', '''[[nyph0mane]]''', '''[[Shimmy]]''' and '''[[Vroggy]]''' replace [[ASiss]], [[visoleki]], [[Axyeri]], [[SANDMAENNCHEN]], [[nesrilaS]] and [[Sense]].<ref>[http://team.gamed.de/index2.php?include=inc/news.php&id=981 LoL: Neues Team stellt sich vor (German)] ''team.gamed.de''</ref>
* June 3, '''[[affe19]]''', '''[[gazek]]''', '''[[dX]]''', '''[[Pancakenik]]''', '''[[maxell]]''' and '''[[Kxng]]''' replace [[Vroggy]], [[Gruhlum]], [[Entenzwerg]], [[Shimmy]] and [[Arroganz]].<ref>[http://team.gamed.de/index2.php?include=inc/news.php&id=1052 Das neue Lineup steht! (German)] ''team.gamed.de''</ref>
* October 4, '''[[Platin]]''', '''[[Buddha]]''', '''[[Luetti]]''' and '''[[Bambino]]''' replace [[Glukoza]], [[affe19]], [[Pancakenik]], [[maxell]] and [[Kxng]].<ref>[http://team.gamed.de/index2.php?include=inc/news.php&id=1073 Nun wird es ernst (German)] ''team.gamed.de''</ref>
{{TDRight|tab}}<!--2011-->
* February 18, team is formed with '''[[reyk]]''', '''[[CandyPanda]]''', '''[[kev1n]]''', '''[[koenig]]''', '''[[Nyph]]''', '''[[Osaft22]]''', '''[[Malya]]''' and '''[[talol]]''' join.<ref>[http://team.gamed.de/index2.php?include=inc/news.php&id=778 Frischfleisch: LoL EPS und CoD4 ! (German)] ''team.gamed.de''</ref>
* June 23, [[Candy Panda]] and [[Nyph]] leave.<ref>[http://www.sk-gaming.com/content/33672-SKLoL_announce_new_lineup SK.LoL announce new line-up] ''sk-gaming.com''</ref>
* June 25, gamed!de disbands their League of Legends roster.<ref>[http://team.gamed.de/index2.php?include=inc/news.php&id=870 Es heißt Abschied nehmen (German)] ''team.gamed.de''</ref>
* July 3, gamed!de picks up new roster including: '''[[Glukoza]]''', '''[[ASiss]]''', '''[[visoleki]]''', '''[[Axyeri]]''', '''[[SANDMAENNCHEN]]''' and '''[[nesrilaS]]'''.<ref>[http://team.gamed.de/index2.php?include=inc/news.php&id=873 LoL-Team wieder komplett (German)] ''team.gamed.de''</ref>
* August 2, '''[[Sense]]''' joins.<ref>[http://team.gamed.de/index2.php?include=inc/news.php&id=894 Zuwachs im Team (German)] ''team.gamed.de''</ref>
{{TDRight/end}}
